title: Pokémon Horizons Anime's Video Previews Pokémon GO Collaboration Episode
content: The staff of the Pokémon: Horizons anime revealed a promotional video on Wednesday previewing the collaboration between the anime and the Pokémon GO app. The Pokémon GO -themed episode, the 150th episode of the overall anime, will air on September 18 and will feature the app's Professor Willow.
author: ANN

title: Aoashi Season 2 Anime's Promo Video Reveals, Previews Theme Songs
content: The staff of the television anime of Yūgo Kobayashi 's Aoashi manga revealed a new promotional video for the second season of the anime on Wednesday. The video previews the anime's theme songs , revealing their titles.
author: ANN

title: Apprentice Nail Artist in a Foreign Land Anime Reveals Main Staff
content: The official X/Twitter account for Shufu to Seikatsu Sha 's Comic PASH! magazine revealed the main staff for the anime adaptation of Marukawa 's Apprentice Nail Artist in a Foreign Land ( Ikyō no Tsumenuri Minarai ) manga on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Exclusive: Fantagraphics Previews Akane Torikai's Wandering Cat's Cage Manga
content: Fantagraphics ' new Takumigraphics imprint for East Asian comics revealed a preview of the English version Akane Torikai 's Wandering Cat's Cage ( Mandarin Gypsy Cat no Rōjō ) manga on Wednesday. The manga was previously scheduled for a May 26 release but is now slated for October 27.
author: ANN

title: The Horror Anime That Took Netflix by Storm Announces Its Grand Finale
content: In the anime horror world, there simply aren’t enough creepy stories to match the world-shattering action series and/or romantic comedies that populate the medium. When a horror anime series makes its way into the world, many fans take notice, especially if it wasn’t born from Junji Ito, as prolific as the manga…
author: ComicBook

title: Pokémon Anime and Pokémon GO Collaboration Episode and In-Game Event Announced
content: Pokémon Horizons: The Series anime and Pokémon GO are teaming up for a new collaboration covering both the TV series and the mobile game. A special anime episode will air in Japan on September 18, while an accompanying Pokémon GO event will run worldwide from September 16 to 22.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Kanata kara' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Main Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyouko Hikawa 's Kanata kara ( From Far Away ) manga revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, a key visual (pictured), and the main promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 5 at 12.00 a.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless First Anime Opening Featuring "Drawing days" by SPLAY
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its very first opening, featuring SPLAY’s “Drawing days,” as part of the series’ ongoing 20th anniversary celebrations. The opening was used for Episodes 1-26 of the TV anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: A Mysterious Figure Appears in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 11 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 11 preview images and synopsis ahead of its September 6 premiere. The episode previously revealed its title to be “Turning Point 4,” with fans already ready for it to be another major moment in Rudy’s life.
author: Anime Corner

title: From Far Away TV Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast & Staff, Theme Songs
content: The official website for the television anime of Kyouko Hikawa 's From Far Away ( Kanata Kara ) shōjo manga presented the anime's main promotional video, key visual, and additional cast and staff members on Wednesday. The video announces and previews the opening theme song "Tōkōkō" by boy group Genin wa Jibun ni Aru.
author: ANN
